map.方程求解器支持一元一次/二次、二元及三元线性方程组求解，输入系数实时输出根或解，: Equation Solver solves linear/quadratic in one variable and linear systems of two/three variables; enter coefficients to get roots or solutions in real time, suitable for math homework, engineering and system verification.
map.一次方程：x = −b / a；二次方程：x = (−b ± √Δ) / 2a，: Linear: x = -b / a; quadratic: x = (-b ± sqrt(Δ)) / 2a, Δ = b^2 - 4ac; cubic: Newton iteration + bisection for all real roots
map.一次方程直接求解；二次方程先算判别式 Δ = b² − 4ac，Δ > 0 得两: Linear equations solved directly; quadratic first computes discriminant Δ = b^2 - 4ac, Δ>0 gives two real roots, Δ=0 a double root, Δ<0 outputs a conjugate complex pair; cubic uses Newton's method with interval scanning for all real roots.
map.一元一次/二次方程求解用于物理公式变形、盈亏平衡点与运动学求时间。: Linear/quadratic equation solving is used for physics formula rearrangement, break-even points, and kinematics time finding.
map.判别式 Δ 决定二次方程实根个数，是解题第一判据。: The discriminant Δ determines the number of real roots of a quadratic; it is the first criterion for solving.
map.验证根时把解代回原方程，看是否约等于 0，可快速发现输入错误。: When verifying roots, substitute the solution into the original equation to see if it is approximately 0; this quickly catches input errors.

map.判别式 Δ 代表什么？: What does the discriminant Δ represent?
map.Δ = b²−4ac：Δ>0 两不等实根，Δ=0 两相等实根（重根），Δ<0 无: Δ = b^2 - 4ac: Δ>0 two distinct real roots, Δ=0 two equal real roots (double root), Δ<0 no real root but a pair of conjugate complex roots. It is the first criterion for judging root nature.
